lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple rows of high-luminance circular blobs arranged in roughly horizontal trajectories posterior to the gill slits across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated intensity intersecting the horizontal blob rows to form a subtle rectangular grid pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal ridge running across the upper flank characterized by a sharp transition from high-intensity light on the dorsal edge to shadow on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of several dark, elongated silhouettes attached to the ventral and pectoral regions consistent with commensal remoras.
